basis: Every FY26 guidance metric was met, adjusted EPS of ZAR 6.51 beat the top of its range and the company is GAAP-profitable for the first time. FY27 adjusted EPS guidance of ZAR 7.50-8.50 plus a stated ambition of 40%+ adjusted EPS growth a year is positive. It is tempered by a soft Q1 guide (restructuring), a Merchant segment that fell, and an immaterial prior-period error revision.
